artifact.description: A consumer offers Care at a meaningful absence. The act is real and complete, and persists as a PersonalVisitorHistory entry, with zero world-state delta.
artifact.episode: The Empty Chair (BH-E002; MULTI-REGISTER-CONSEQUENCE-CLASSES.md's Care example)
artifact.notes: This is the first fixture to actually instantiate the RELATIONAL register (previously specified in schema and protected by rule R03, but never exercised by any LS-COMPILER-01 fixture). Confirms the register validates with no worldStateDelta field present at all — its structural absence, not merely its optionality, is what R03 protects.
